descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · S25 「换了大小写的邮箱登录到同一个医生，而不是第二个（在登录路由上）」 An email in a different case signs in to the same physician, not a second one (at the sign-in route)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U6 Open sign-up: a new email that was never invited signs in with the emailed code. The physician is created and appears in the physician list.（UAT OAT-01 step 6；UAT OAT-01 Expected；TFA-94513 AC 13） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given The local stack's auth API and an unseeded address qa-case-<tag>@roundai.test

When Issue a code for the lower-case address and POST /api/auth/sign-in/email-otp with QA-Case-<tag>@RoundAI.test and that code; record the acceptance; sign out; sign in again with the lower-case address.

Then There is one Better Auth user row for the address. The second sign-in reuses it: the acceptance is found and the agreements screen is not due again.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：U6 / AC 13 'end up in the same physician list': two user rows for one address, or an acceptance not found on the second sign-in, = Fail. The UI cannot show this, because AuthGate lower-cases the email before sending (src/components/auth/AuthGate.tsx), so the earlier browser version of this case could never fail. Which table counts as the physician list is Q4. …

在哪跑：本地 newspec-a（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S25 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-a。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数）；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：newspec-a。

UAT item: OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-01/S25

An email in a different case signs in to the same physician, not a second one (at the sign-in route)

Tickets: TFA-94513 Signing In & Session Security (in progress)

本地新 lane newspec-a：newspec-a/results.json 里 status passed → 通过（通过）。

怎么测（newspec-a/plan.json，automatable: yes）：New api spec: fresh unseeded address qa-case-<tag>@roundai.test; issue a code for the lower-case form (seed:issueTestOtp) and POST /api/auth/sign-in/email-otp with QA-Case-<tag>@RoundAI.test; record the acceptance; sign out; sign in again lower-case; compare user ids and agreements:current acceptedVersion; count user rows with that email (betterAuth user table via the convex CLI, filtered by the test's address before parsing, rows split by raw newlines joined back). — Pure auth-route calls on the local stack.

Detail:

QA-Case-<tag>@RoundAI.test signs in (200) with a code issued for the lower-case form; the stored email is lower-case; after sign-out the lower-case address signs in to the SAME user id; the acceptance made on the first sign-in is found (acceptedVersion = version 2026-10-05, screen not due); exactly one Better Auth user row for the address (read with the convex CLI from the betterAuth component). Re-run in final2 after making the user-row read robust (filtered by the test's own address; rows split by another job's raw newline are joined back): still exactly one row, same user id.
